name: secure-ai
description: AI-feature security for your builds: static checks for how an app feeds and trusts a model (a model key in browser code, caller input in the system prompt, secrets inside prompt text, model output reaching raw HTML, eval, a shell or string-built SQL, Markdown that can load attacker images, tools that fetch a URL the model chose), and a red-team probe that sends twelve prompt-injection probes to a LOCAL dev server and grades the replies by canary and markup, with no model in the grading. Requires secure-core.
